theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) (μHE[n].restrict M) → (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) univ = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * μHE[n] M ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) (closedBall 0 R) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n) * (μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a (lam * R)) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ((lam * R) ^ n))) ∧ (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) (ball 0 R) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n) * (μHE[n] (M ∩ ball a (lam * R)) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ((lam * R) ^ n))) ∧ ∫⁻ y in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖θ (a + lam • y) • ζ (a + lam • y) - θ a • ζ a‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n) * ((∫⁻ x in M ∩ closedBall a (lam * R), ‖θ x • ζ x - θ a • ζ a‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ((lam * R) ^ n)))
